integrity: The proof begins from the exact window-series and branch formulas in arXiv:2609.37459v1. The leading asymptotic is symbolic; finite computation only checks branch identities and corroborates the scale.
scientific_limitations: Determines only the leading logarithmic coefficient for the symmetric-slice window as \(Q\to\infty\); it does not prove the fitted constant term, finite-\(Q\) unimodality, or global optimality of Bai's point.
title: Leading logarithmic law for the Salikhov–Zeilberger–Zudilin–Bai window on the symmetric slice
